EquipmentLibrary.Description: XCGF standard library: sensor definitions. Sensor derives into Radar, ESM, InfraredSensor and VisualSensor, following the sensor data of CMO (see docs/cmo-mapping.md). Concrete sensors derive from these definitions.

EquipmentDefinition.name: Sensor
EquipmentDefinition.Description: Root sensor: role, generation, coverage (ranges, altitudes, arcs), scan rate and capabilities. Every sensor derives from it.

Parameter.name: Role
Parameter.Description: Main role of the sensor.

Parameter.name: Generation
Parameter.Description: Technology generation, which scales detection performance.

Parameter.name: MinRange
Parameter.Description: Shortest distance at which the sensor detects a target.

Parameter.name: MaxRange
Parameter.Description: Farthest distance at which the sensor detects a target. Targets beyond it are never detected.

Parameter.name: MinAltitude
Parameter.Description: Lowest target altitude the sensor detects.

Parameter.name: MaxAltitude
Parameter.Description: Highest target altitude the sensor detects.

Parameter.name: ScanInterval
Parameter.Description: Time between two detection attempts on the same target.

Parameter.name: Capabilities
Parameter.Description: Kinds of targets detected and information reported about a contact.

Parameter.name: DetectionArcs
Parameter.Description: Sectors where the sensor detects. All around the platform when absent.

Parameter.name: MaxContacts
Parameter.Description: Highest number of contacts the sensor follows at once.

Parameter.name: Operational
Parameter.Description: Whether the sensor works when the entity is created (false: damaged or out of service).

EquipmentDefinition.name: Radar
EquipmentDefinition.Description: Active radar: emission (power, gain, pulse), reception (noise, processing gain) and resolutions. Its detections depend on the radar cross section of the target in its band.

Parameter.name: FrequencyBands
Parameter.Description: Bands the radar emits in. They select the target's radar cross section (A-D or E-M) and the receivers able to intercept it.

Parameter.name: PeakPower
Parameter.Description: Peak emitted power.

Parameter.name: AntennaGain
Parameter.Description: Gain of the antenna.

Parameter.name: HorizontalBeamwidth
Parameter.Description: Horizontal width of the beam.

Parameter.name: VerticalBeamwidth
Parameter.Description: Vertical width of the beam.

Parameter.name: PulseWidth
Parameter.Description: Duration of one pulse.

Parameter.name: PulseRepetitionFrequency
Parameter.Description: Number of pulses per second.

Parameter.name: SystemNoiseLevel
Parameter.Description: Noise level of the receiver.

Parameter.name: ProcessingGain
Parameter.Description: Gain (or loss, when negative) brought by signal processing.

Parameter.name: RangeResolution
Parameter.Description: Smallest range difference at which two targets are told apart.

Parameter.name: AngularResolution
Parameter.Description: Smallest bearing difference at which two targets are told apart.

Parameter.name: Features
Parameter.Description: Processing features (pulse-Doppler, look-down/shoot-down, track-while-scan...).

Parameter.name: TrackingArcs
Parameter.Description: Sectors where the radar can track or illuminate a target. The detection arcs when absent.

Parameter.name: MaxIlluminatedTargets
Parameter.Description: Highest number of targets illuminated at once for weapon guidance; 0 for a radar without fire control.

Parameter.name: Mode
Parameter.Description: Operating mode of the radar when the entity is created. Off keeps the platform silent (emission control).

EquipmentDefinition.name: ESM
EquipmentDefinition.Description: Passive electronic support measures, radar warning receivers included: detects and identifies emitters, without emitting.

Parameter.name: FrequencyBands
Parameter.Description: Bands the receiver listens to. Emitters outside them are not intercepted.

Parameter.name: Sensitivity
Parameter.Description: Weakest received power the receiver detects.

Parameter.name: BearingAccuracy
Parameter.Description: Accuracy of the bearing measured on an emitter.

Parameter.name: EmitterIdentification
Parameter.Description: Whether the receiver identifies the type of an intercepted emitter.

EquipmentDefinition.name: InfraredSensor
EquipmentDefinition.Description: Passive infrared sensor (IRST, FLIR, missile approach warner). Its detections depend on the infrared signature of the target.

Parameter.name: Band
Parameter.Description: Infrared band of the detector.

Parameter.name: Imaging
Parameter.Description: Whether the sensor forms an image, which allows classifying contacts.

Parameter.name: FieldOfView
Parameter.Description: Instantaneous field of view of the detector.

EquipmentDefinition.name: VisualSensor
EquipmentDefinition.Description: Visual or electro-optical sensor (eye, TV camera). Its detections depend on the visual signature of the target.

Parameter.name: NightCapable
Parameter.Description: Whether the sensor works at night (low-light camera, night vision).

Parameter.name: FieldOfView
Parameter.Description: Instantaneous field of view of the sensor.
